title: The Gradient Difference Induced by Detaching the Denominator in QK Normalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.33887v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: QK normalization divides each query and key by its own RMS norm before the attention scores are computed. Treating this denominator as a constant during backpropagation leaves the forward pass unchanged but alters the parameter gradients. We derive a closed form for the difference between the gradient under this detached rule and the gradient under the standard rule. For a single token, this difference is parallel to the token's own query; it changes only the query norm and has no first-order effect after normalization. The queries, however, are computed by a projection matrix $W_Q$ shared across all tokens. translated_title: QK归一化中分离分母所引起的梯度差异
translated_abstract: QK归一化在计算注意力分数之前，将每个query和key除以其自身的RMS范数。在反向传播中将该分母视为常数（即detach处理）不会改变前向传播的结果，但会改变参数的梯度。我们推导出了该detach规则下的梯度与标准规则下的梯度之间差异的闭式表达形式。对于单个token，这一梯度差异与该token自身的query方向平行；它只改变query的范数，在归一化之后没有一阶效应。然而，query是由所有token共享的投影矩阵 $W_Q$ 计算得到的。因此，$W_Q$ 上的梯度差异等于 $W_Q$ 右乘一个输入的加权二阶矩，并且可以精确分解为三个分量：仅改变 $W_Q$ 范数的径向分量、改变其他token的query方向的切向分量，以及改变上游的上游分量。
tldr: 本文推导了QK归一化中detach分母所引起的参数梯度差异的闭式形式，证明该差异在单个token上仅改变query范数（归一化后无一阶效应），而在共享的投影矩阵 $W_Q$ 上可精确分解为径向、切向和上游三个分量。
